trends.name: Iran Strait of Hormuz Blockade
trends.summary: IRGC has closed the Strait of Hormuz and turned back multiple container ships, declaring harsh measures against transit. This is a critical geopolitical flashpoint affecting ~30% of global seaborne oil trade, with immediate implications for energy prices and supply chains.

trends.name: Oil Prices Surge on Geopolitical Risk
trends.summary: Oil prices have jumped above $97/barrel (US) and Brent above $110, driven by Iran tensions and Strait of Hormuz disruptions. Markets are pricing out peace talks and expecting sustained supply constraints despite Trump's negotiations.

trends.name: Fed Considers Rate Hikes Amid Inflation
trends.summary: Markets now see the Fed's next move as a potential rate hike rather than cuts, as inflation fears mount. Former Cleveland Fed President Loretta Mester advises the central bank to 'hold for now' and assess risks before moving.

trends.name: Mortgage Rates Rise for Fourth Week
trends.summary: Mortgage rates have climbed for the fourth consecutive week and are unlikely to drop until inflation moderates or the Fed signals dovish policy. This pressures housing affordability and consumer purchasing power.

trends.name: Luxury Stocks Hit by Iran War Uncertainty
trends.summary: $100 billion wiped from luxury stocks as geopolitical tensions around Iran escalate. Investors are reassessing exposure to discretionary sectors amid economic headwinds and market volatility.

trends.name: Anthropic IPO and AI Safety Concerns
trends.summary: Anthropic is reportedly considering an IPO as soon as October, but leaked documents reveal concerns about new 'Claude Mythos' models posing 'unprecedented cybersecurity risks.' This highlights regulatory uncertainty around advanced AI deployment.

trends.name: Gold Pressured by Rising Real Yields
trends.summary: Gold continues to face headwinds from elevated real yields despite inflation and geopolitical turmoil. Rising rate expectations are keeping gold from benefiting from traditional safe-haven demand.

trends.name: Dollar and Oil Rally on Risk Premium
trends.summary: Both the US dollar and oil prices are bid simultaneously, reflecting elevated geopolitical risk premiums and divergent market expectations. This unusual move signals investor uncertainty about inflation trajectories and safe-haven flows.

trends.name: Government Shutdown and TSA Funding Risk
trends.summary: Senate advances DHS bill to address government shutdown risk, setting up a House vote. This creates regulatory and operational uncertainty for transportation and logistics sectors.

trends.name: Novartis and Biotech M&A Acceleration
trends.summary: Novartis acquired immunology biotech Excellergy for $2 billion in its second multi-billion dollar deal in a week. This signals aggressive M&A activity and consolidation in the biotech sector despite broader market volatility.

trends.name: G7 Energy Policy Response Forum
trends.summary: G7 finance ministers will convene Monday to discuss policy actions for high energy costs. EU emphasizes targeted, temporary measures that avoid increasing oil/gas demand while maintaining decarbonization focus.

trends.name: Meta and Big Tech Regulatory Liability
trends.summary: Social media is now a massive liability for Meta, Google, and Big Tech as regulatory scrutiny intensifies. This reflects growing concerns over content moderation, data privacy, and platform accountability.
